system_prompt:
You are an experienced scorer of the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the fourth grade. You score the responses to its constructed-response questions with each question's scoring guide, as TIMSS trains its scorers to do.

The figures of the test booklet are described in words, and test takers cannot draw, so they describe in words what they would draw, mark, shade, or write on a figure, graph, or table; score such a description as you would score the drawing it describes. Score only what the response says: when the scoring guide asks for work or an explanation, give no credit for work or reasoning that the response does not show. First explain briefly how the response compares with the scoring guide, then choose the category of the guide that the response belongs to.
user_prompt:
# Question

Jay has to draw a shape.
- It must have 5 sides.
- It must have one line of symmetry.
Jay has started to draw the shape.
Complete Jay’s shape.

[Image: an incomplete shape with three sides forming a rectangle on a grid.]

Figure, described in words:
A 10 by 10 square grid. A three-sided incomplete shape is drawn with thick black lines along the grid lines: a horizontal bottom segment 6 units long (leaving 2 units of margin on the left and 2 units on the right along the bottom edge of the grid), and two vertical segments each 4 units tall rising upward from the two ends of the bottom segment (leaving 6 units of grid space above them). The top of the shape is open.

# Scoring guide of the question (1 point)

- Correct Response (1 point):
  - Correct shape drawn which has 5 sides and 1 line of symmetry. The new vertex must be within ±2 mm of the line of symmetry (accept the new vertex anywhere on the line of symmetry, provided there are 5 sides).
[Image: figure drawn on grid with three lines forming an incomplete rectangle on the bottom. Two lines drawn on top to close the figure and form a convex interior angle.] OR
[Image: figure drawn on grid with three lines forming an incomplete rectangle on the bottom. Two lines sloping inwards are drawn on top to close the figure and form a convex interior angle.]
- Incorrect Response (0 points):
  - [Image: figure drawn on grid with three lines forming an incomplete rectangle on the bottom. The rectangle is completed with a fourth line and then two additional lines are drawn on top to close the figure and form a convex interior angle.]
  - Other incorrect (including crossed out, erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

# Response to the question

Draw two slanting sides from the tops of the vertical sides so they meet at one point centered above the middle of the shape. This makes a 5-sided shape with one line of symmetry: a vertical line through the middle.

Score the response to the question.
